text:
maya: Heads-up — our HF->Redwood conversion is tripping up JSON-mode tool calls on the new falcon varient.
maya: Reproducer: convert hf model with special token \"<|toolcall|>\" added via config.json, run a chat that uses tool tags, parser fails to find JSON block.
sam: ugh, seen similar when tokenizer splits the tag. can you paste the raw chat + tokens? :thinking_face:
maya: here — minimal convo:\n```\nsystem: You are an assistant.\nuser: Call the `get_price` tool for item id 42.\nassistant: <|toolcall|>{\"name\": \"get_price\", \"args\": {\"id\": 42}}<|endtool|>\n```\nmaya: after tokenization the sentinel becomes two tokens: `['<|', 'toolcall|>']` so our JSON mode detects no sentinel and dumps malformed output.
jordan: probable culprit: the tokenizer wasn't saved with the special token as a single added token. config.json needs `added_tokens` or `special_tokens_map`. some HF tokenizers also need `is_fast`/added tokens handled differently.
lee: also saw this with quantized int8 runs — quantization changed vocab merges slightly (bpe id remapping) leading to split sentinels at runtime.
sam: quick check — does `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens': ['<|toolcall|>']})` fix it locally? if yes then converter should patch tokenizer.json.
maya: i tried `tokenizer.add_special_tokens(...)` and re-saved. fix works for decode/encode tests but the ONNX export still uses original merges unless we patch tokenizer files before conversion.
jordan: suggested converter change: when converting HF -> Redwood, detect any special token strings used by our toolchain (e.g., `<|toolcall|>`, `<json>`, `<|role_sep|>`) and ensure they're in `tokenizer.json` as single tokens. fallback: inject `special_tokens_map` in model card and write `added_tokens.json` for old tokenizers.
sam: loop for PR: 1) reproduce failing eval 2) add pre-conversion check that warnings if sentinels would split 3) auto-insert added_tokens and update merges/tokenizer files 4) run sanity tokenization tests in CI.
maya: eval-bot just posted a failure: \"eval: toolcall-jsonmode - 5/60 examples malformed json\" — linking logs: https://ci.internal/runs/7432
eval-bot: automated message — failing cases show split tokens at boundaries in 4 different languages and when prefix_space=false.
lee: note about prefix_space: some tokenizers require leading space to keep merges, so our chatfmt might be toggling spaces and causing boundary collisions. we need test cases with/without leading spaces.
jordan: small patch idea (python):\n```python\nfrom tokenizers import Tokenizer\n t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')\nif t.encode('<|toolcall|>').get_tokens() != ['<|toolcall|>']:\n    # add as single token\n    t.add_special_tokens(['<|toolcall|>'])\n    t.save('tokenizer.json')\n```\njordan: but for non-fast tokenizers we have to update merges/vocab too — converter must support both.
sam: we should also add an eval that does token-level assert: sentinel appears as single token and sits on token boundary before/after JSON payload.
maya: opened issue #3214 and added failing example. i'll start a small PR to the converter with tests. assigning to @sam for review.
sam: will review. also let's add a short note in onboarding doc: \"If your model uses custom tool sentinels, ensure they're registered as single tokens — see converter docs.\" :memo:
maya: great. thanks everyone. i'll post PR link when ready. :rocket:
